title: Digital Service Booking System
summary: A Django application for managing service bookings, built before my focus moved to applied machine learning.

title: Scholia — Research Paper Summarizer
summary: A local FastAPI app that turns research papers into section-aware summaries, adds an inferred Research Gap segment, and selects faithful sentences with LexRank and MMR.

title: MiniHub — Lightweight GitHub-style Workspace
summary: A minimal GitHub-like workspace for creating repositories, uploading files, and reviewing commit history. Built with Next.js, Express, Prisma, SQLite and isomorphic-git, with an interactive, portfolio-inspired UI.
